name: moai-domain-svg-infographic
description: > Author editable SVG technical infographics — architecture, flow, comparison, hierarchy — by computing the layout numerically before writing markup, then rendering a 2x PNG via headless Chromium. Carries a CJK-first font stack, a deterministic source lint, and mermaid-vs-SVG selection rules.
author: modu-ai
summary_zh: 一套可编辑的 SVG 技术信息图生成方案，适合制作架构、流程、对比和层级图，并稳定输出适配中文的高清图片。
